searches.reason: Establish whether GRU4Rec uses recent intent or stale history through controlled prefix truncation, recent-item removal, and order perturbations. Seek padding-safe probes with matched controls, uncertainty estimates, and links to recurrent-state retention and training signals; sensitivity alone should not be interpreted as recommendation quality.

searches.reason: Connect the reported failures to observable evidence using histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions. Seek a practical annotation protocol separating choose-now relevance, redundancy, explicit incompatibility, and unknown fit, with agreement and uncertainty checks. Do not infer compatibility, mood, ownership needs, or simulator traits from unavailable attributes.
